turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going away for a week and I don't know what to do with my dog.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You've got a few options. Would you prefer a boarding kennel, or a sitter who comes to your home?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you hang on? I have to talk to someone here. I'll tell you when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey Daniel, we only have one free day in the city. Museum or the big market?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The market, obviously. You'd spend six hours reading every little sign in a museum.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: We could do the market in the morning and a short museum visit after lunch?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A short museum visit. You know that's not how I work.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Two hours, max. I'll set an alarm.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fine. But I get to pick where we eat dinner.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: As long as it's not another place with a twenty minute queue.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're finished. Please carry on, Moshi.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. Any decision on the kennel versus a home sitter?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Different question. Three kids starting school in September and the uniform list is long. How do I not go bankrupt?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Only buy the logo items from the official shop. Plain trousers, skirts, polo shirts and jumpers can usually come from any supermarket.
